alignments.note: Quantifier completed by the supplied generic *time*, headed on *Many* under rule 31. Margin *Or, Much* read and set aside under rule 38.
Finite verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17.
Discontinuous *from ... up* for the one ablative preposition, headed on *from* under rules 24 and 25; the competing reading marks *up* `added` under rule 30.
`גַּם` rendered by the adversative connective *Yet*; the ASV's word is what the particle is rendered by, so it is not `added`.
Negative takes its own written *not*; the ASV writes the negation and the verb separately, so rule 35's fusion does not arise.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary, discontinuous around the negative under rule 25, headed on the lexical verb.
Preposition rendered *against*, the relation the ASV wrote for it.

review_notes: The verse repeats PSA.129.1's opening colon and is aligned the same way, but on its own tokens under rule 10.
`לֹא` keeps only *not*: the ASV writes *have not prevailed* rather than a fused negative-modal, so rule 35's `cannot` case does not reach it.
